release_notes:
# Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.3.1 — Licensing hotfix

- Rechecks the signed license entitlement before starting a transcription and
  before each new file in a batch, including when Vidrick has been left open
  past the entitlement's expiration.
- Stops new transcription work when licensing has expired and cannot be
  renewed. Work already in progress is allowed to finish.
- Keeps completed exports available if licensing expires between files in a
  batch, with a licensing message instead of a crash report.
- Preserves valid offline access and allows an expired cached entitlement to
  refresh after a subscription renewal when the licensing service is reachable.

This update does not change transcription models, speaker identification, or
local audio processing. Install 4.3.1 to receive the desktop fix; an already
installed 4.3 copy is not changed by the server-side safeguards alone.
